titleEn: Carbon Robotics Launches Carbon Autonomy Ready Program, Great Plains Manufacturing Joins as First Member
titleZh: Carbon Robotics推出“Carbon自主就绪计划”，Great Plains Manufacturing成为首家成员
summaryZh: Carbon Robotics宣布启动“Carbon Autonomy Ready”计划，旨在为各类农具制定技术规范，使其能无缝集成到Carbon自主平台中。Great Plains Manufacturing作为首家成员加入，其Implement Command®系统与Carbon Autonomy集成后，可实现农具设置的实时自动调整，如深度、下压力等，无需驾驶员操作。该合作将在2026年Farm Progress Show上展示，标志着农业自动化迈向更开放的生态。
featuredReason: 该新闻展示了农业自动化与农具生态开放集成的趋势，对智慧畜牧中的大田作业环节具有前瞻参考价值，值得关注自动化技术如何提升作业效率。
contentFull:
By Carbon Robotics 

 

 Share

 

 

 

 

 

 Carbon Robotics, a worldwide leader in physical AI for agriculture, today announced the launch of its Carbon Autonomy Ready program. Great Plains Manufacturing, a leading manufacturer of seeding and soil management equipment, joins the program as the first member.

 Designed to support a wide range of implements that farmers use today, the Carbon Autonomy Ready program establishes a technical specification and process for integrating any manufacturers’ implements directly into the Carbon Autonomy platform.

 Great Plains’ capabilities, featuring their Implement Command® system, provides an elevated starting block for the partnership to yield positive results for farmers. Tractors running Carbon Autonomy will connect real-time data from Great Plains’ equipment and enable autonomous adjustments on the fly. The integrated solution delivers automated reading and adjusting of additional implement settings, including depth, down pressure, and leveling, the same way an operator would if they were physically operating the tractor.

 “We believe the Carbon Autonomy platform can transform the ways that modern farmers work their fields, and Great Plains is the perfect first partner to launch this program,” said Carbon Robotics Founder and CEO Paul Mikesell. “Our belief is that autonomous farming implements will help farmers be more efficient and lower costs by extending working hours, solving skilled operator shortages, and increasing tractor utilization.”

 “At Great Plains, we see producers continually fine-tuning their operations to capture small, incremental gains in yield and efficiency. Real-time adjustments will be critical to maximizing those efforts,” said Doug Jennings, Sr. Product Manager at Great Plains. “We look forward to expanding sensing, communication, and control channels through this agreement with Carbon Robotics to provide producers with the most efficient, timely field adjustments possible.”

 The integration between Carbon Autonomy and Great Plains will be showcased at the 2026 Farm Progress Show with a Great Plains HT1100 Terra-Max® equipped with integrated sensors and a Carbon implement kit both on display.

translationZh:
Carbon Robotics，农业物理AI领域的全球领导者，今日宣布推出其“Carbon Autonomy Ready”计划。Great Plains Manufacturing，一家领先的播种和土壤管理设备制造商，作为首家成员加入该计划。

该计划旨在支持农民目前使用的各种农具，为将任何制造商的农具直接集成到Carbon Autonomy平台中建立技术规范和流程。

Great Plains的能力，以其Implement Command®系统为特色，为合作伙伴关系提供了一个高起点的平台，有望为农民带来积极成果。运行Carbon Autonomy的拖拉机将实时连接Great Plains设备的数据，并能够即时进行自主调整。该集成解决方案能够像操作员实际驾驶拖拉机时那样，自动读取和调整额外的农具设置，包括深度、下压力和水平。

“我们相信Carbon Autonomy平台能够改变现代农民耕作方式，而Great Plains是启动这一计划的完美首个合作伙伴，”Carbon Robotics创始人兼CEO Paul Mikesell表示。“我们相信，自主农业农具将通过延长工作时间、解决熟练操作员短缺问题以及提高拖拉机利用率，帮助农民提高效率并降低成本。”

随着农民将自主拖拉机用于更多田间作业，从土地准备到激光除草，Carbon Autonomy Ready计划旨在与任何农具制造商合作，以便农民能够选择最适合其作业的设备，同时不牺牲自主性。

“在Great Plains，我们看到生产者不断微调他们的操作，以获取产量和效率上的微小增量收益。实时调整对于最大化这些努力至关重要，”Great Plains高级产品经理Doug Jennings表示。“我们期待通过这份与Carbon Robotics的协议，扩展传感、通信和控制渠道，为生产者提供最高效、最及时的田间调整。”

Carbon Autonomy与Great Plains之间的集成将在2026年Farm Progress Show上展示，届时将展出配备集成传感器和Carbon农具套件的Great Plains HT1100 Terra-Max®。
